heading: Hello, Fellow Book Lover!
bioParagraphs: Welcome to my cozy corner of the literary world. I'm your companion through countless literary adventures, the one who stays up just a little too late reading because just one more chapter is always the lie I tell myself.

There's something magical about losing yourself in a good book under the soft glow of lamplight while the moon watches through the window. The world gets quiet, the tea gets cold, and suddenly you're somewhere else entirely.

Here I share my reading journey, the books that made me think, the stories that made me feel, and the words that stayed with me long after I turned the last page. I read across genres, but I have a particular soft spot for atmospheric fiction, thoughtful fantasy, and anything that makes me look at the world differently.
Pull up a chair, make yourself a cup of tea, and let's talk books.
